Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. Render a natural-color editorial photograph with visibly colored skin, clothing, architecture, and landscape. An adult stands frontally with level shoulders and loosely clasped hands in a quiet pale-stone museum hall with deep openings and sparse displays, wearing visible outerwear body ending below the waist and fitted top, with a calm attentive look with a level chin and focused eyes. Use waist-up natural perspective with complete visible hand gestures and a large diffused key blended with ambient light. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery.
